description: Extracts namespace, normalizes toponyms, and adds timestamp

script.description: Normalize toponyms: store original as label, create toponym_id from normalized name
script.source: if (ctx.toponyms != null) { def validToponyms = []; def seen = new HashSet(); for (def t : ctx.toponyms) { def origId = t.toponym_id; if (origId == null || !origId.contains('@')) { continue; } int atPos = origId.lastIndexOf('@'); if (atPos <= 0) { continue; } def origName = origId.substring(0, atPos); def lang = origId.substring(atPos + 1); if (origName.length() == 0 || lang.length() == 0) { continue; } t.label = origName; def normalized = origName; normalized = /\s*\([^)]*\)\s*/.matcher(normalized).replaceAll(' '); normalized = /\s*\[[^\]]*\]\s*/.matcher(normalized).replaceAll(' '); normalized = /\s*\{[^}]*\}\s*/.matcher(normalized).replaceAll(' '); if (normalized.contains(',')) { normalized = normalized.splitOnToken(',')[0]; } if (normalized.contains(' - ')) { normalized = normalized.splitOnToken(' - ')[0]; } if (normalized.contains(' / ')) { normalized = normalized.splitOnToken(' / ')[0]; } normalized = /[0-9;:!?@#$%^&*+=<>|\\~`"]/.matcher(normalized).replaceAll(''); normalized = /\s+/.matcher(normalized).replaceAll(' ').trim(); if (normalized.length() < 2) { continue; } def newId = normalized + '@' + lang; if (seen.contains(newId)) { continue; } seen.add(newId); t.toponym_id = newId; validToponyms.add(t); } ctx.toponyms = validToponyms; }
